dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual widening from the anterior head to the mid-section followed by a sharp, linear reduction in planar width toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Largely symmetrical margins with a slight convex expansion on the right lateral edge; posterior margins are partially obscured by suspended sediment.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-frequency blue-grey shadow gradients along the right dorsal-lateral slope.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark elliptical point corresponding to the blowhole at the anterior dorsal position.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge beginning at the mid-thorax and extending to the posterior, creating a distinct linear shadow-casting edge.
